about.titleLine1: Mining is built on more than resources.
about.description1: Mining companies operate at the intersection of communities, governments, investors, media and public opinion. In this environment, reputation is not simply a communications issue — it is a strategic asset.
about.description2: Mining & Reputation supports mining companies in understanding their stakeholders, building credible narratives, navigating sensitive issues and strengthening the relationships that sustain their licence to operate.

hero.heading: Reputation at the heart of mining performance.
hero.p1: Mining operates under intense scrutiny. Every project exists within a network of communities, institutions, investors, employees, media and public expectations.
hero.p2: Mining & Reputation was created to help mining organisations navigate that environment with stronger communication, deeper stakeholder understanding and greater credibility.

mission.text: Our mission is to strengthen the relationship between mining organisations and the stakeholders who influence their ability to operate, grow and create long-term value.

crisis.title: Crisis Communication
crisis.tagline: Protect trust when the pressure is highest.
crisis.intro: Mining operations can face incidents, community tensions, regulatory issues, environmental concerns or rapidly evolving media narratives. Effective crisis communication requires preparation long before a crisis begins.

media.title: Media Relations & Spokesperson Strategy
media.tagline: Be represented with clarity and authority.
media.intro: Coverage of mining is shaped by journalists, analysts and commentators who rarely have time to seek context. Strong media relationships and well-prepared spokespeople determine whether your position is heard accurately.

esg.title: ESG, CSR & Social Licence to Operate
esg.intro: Investors, regulators and communities increasingly judge mining companies on evidence rather than intention. ESG communication has to connect what an organisation does with what its stakeholders can verify.

community.title: Community Relations
community.tagline: Build dialogue where operations meet people.
community.intro: Local communities live with the daily reality of a mining project. Sustained, honest dialogue is what turns consultation into trust, and trust into a durable licence to operate.

financial.title: Financial Communication
financial.tagline: Communicate value to the people who fund it.
financial.intro: Investors, lenders and partners assess mining projects through disclosure, guidance and management credibility. Financial communication must be precise, consistent and aligned with operational reality.

digital.title: Digital Reputation & Monitoring
digital.tagline: Know how you are seen before it matters.
digital.intro: Perception now forms online, often faster than an organisation can respond. Continuous monitoring turns scattered signals into early warning, and early warning into time to act.
